hypothesis: A target-specific control profile matched to the target's batch composition removes batch, depth, and state confounding from production donor rows and improves transferable per-gene direction.

production_overlap.a15_k562_path: The live a15 model already uses a 50:50 incumbent-K562/PerturbMatch K562-slot ensemble on PerturbMatch-supported genes.
production_overlap.perturbmatch: PerturbMatch is a limma-voom matched-control reanalysis of the same Replogle K562 assay.
production_overlap.interpretation: K562 batch matching is a processing-replicate diagnostic with partial mechanism overlap. Orion batch matching is the genuinely new production lever.

weighting_audit.derivation: For batch count sums S_tb and U_tb=sum_g S_tbg, the pooled target composition is sum_b S_tb / sum_b U_tb = sum_b (U_tb/sum_b U_tb)*(S_tb/U_tb). Therefore a control counterfactual for the same sum-then-normalize pseudobulk must weight batch-normalized controls by target total UMI, not target-cell count.
weighting_audit.k562_schema_fact: On the preregistration control-only audit, ncounts equaled the analyzed X row sum exactly; UMI_count did not and is excluded.
weighting_audit.orion_schema_fact: On the preregistration control-only audit, total_counts equaled the sparse gene_expression sum exactly.

retention.k562: exact incumbent target axis; all source cells carrying each retained perturbation label; control label control
retention.orion: pass_guide_filter == 1; exact incumbent target axis; candidate controls use the explicit allowlist gene_target == Non-Targeting; NEGR1 is always a perturbation

candidate_sources.target_profile: Reconstruct exact incumbent b_target as delta_global + b_ctrl_global.
candidate_sources.eta_zero_rule: Eta zero literally copies the existing delta.npy rows; it never traverses a reconstructed arithmetic path.
candidate_sources.global_control_reconstruction_audit: K562 and a separately scanned legacy-Orion control pool reconstruct the frozen b_ctrl.npy within max absolute log-profile error <= 2e-6. Exact Non-Targeting-only Orion controls are not required to equal the legacy artifact; their discrepancy is measured and recorded.
candidate_sources.orion_legacy_control_bug: The incumbent regex ^neg classified NEGR1 as control. The candidate never does so. Legacy pooling is retained only as a provenance reconstruction audit.
candidate_sources.matched_control: Normalize controls separately within every contributing batch, then average those normalized profiles with target total-UMI weights.
candidate_sources.unsupported: Zero correction and bit-exact incumbent row at every eta.
candidate_sources.development_support_expectation: All 613 development targets are common to all three production donor tables and are expected to have valid control mixtures.

metrics: complete-gallery raw cosine PDS with exact midranks
outcomes.k562_macro_weighting: K562-GWPS and K562-essential average to one biological-family contribution.

geometry.donor_weights: equal among allowed carrying production donors
geometry.donor_renormalization: eta-zero incumbent median centered-row norm, fixed for every eta and null
geometry.production_precision: Reproduce Donor.decompose and donor median-norm scaling in float32 exactly as the live MultiDonorModel, then cast selected centered basis rows to float64 before covariance accumulation as scripts/build_union_whitener.py does.
geometry.correction_centering: For raw control correction r_t=b_ctrl_global-b_ctrl_matched,t and mu_r=mean(r_t over supported source rows), use centered correction r_t-mu_r on supported rows and exactly zero on unsupported rows.
geometry.unsupported_production_warning: The 613-target development set does not exercise unsupported rows. Any a15 integration involving unsupported rows requires a separate frozen integration gate.
geometry.whitener: a15 union_pruned signal covariance from exact eta-zero/global-control centered production donor rows
geometry.whitener_basis: One numpy default_rng(0) consumed in production donor order; retain all rows when a donor has <=12000 rows, otherwise choose 12000 without replacement and sort; after the cap, remove rows whose perturbation is in data/donors/k562_essential/perts.txt. Apply this algorithm separately to each allowed outer-source donor set on the 4,992-gene response axis.
geometry.basis_selection_provenance: Each outer group freezes source-row counts, post-cap/prune retained counts, dropped counts, and SHA-256 hashes of the selected int64 row-index arrays.
geometry.whitener_fit: separate inside each outer held-source calculation; K562-held excludes K562-GWPS; RPE1/Jurkat use all three production donors
geometry.reason_fixed_operator: Reuses the exact incumbent geometry and isolates the target-specific control correction from covariance and donor-scale changes.
geometry.preserve_renorm: One positive panel-global scalar after transformation; omitted from endpoint arithmetic because both PDS and signed credit are exactly invariant to it.

development.fold_definition: contiguous numpy.array_split blocks preserving Experiment 132's frozen development-target order
development.selection: Within each fold, select among eta 0, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0 on inner targets with an inner-only PDS gallery. Eligible candidates must have nonnegative PDS and signed-credit deltas in every scored biological family. Maximize biological-family macro PDS, then macro signed credit, then smaller eta.
development.held_scoring: Evaluate held queries against the complete 613-target gallery.
development.final_eta: Apply the same deterministic selection rule once on all 613 development targets.
development.component_diagnostics: After the primary all-donor eta selections are frozen, report all-donor, Orion-only, and K562-only arms using those same fold-specific and final eta values without retuning. Diagnostics do not change the primary PASS decision; they are frozen evidence for later a15 integration.

randomness.target_label_null: Apply one common derangement to matched-control correction rows across all allowed donors, preserving cross-donor correction coherence while breaking target identity.
randomness.batch_mixture_null: Apply independent donor-specific derangements to target-to-batch-mixture correction rows, preserving each donor's correction distribution while breaking target identity and cross-donor alignment.
randomness.bootstrap_blocks: Connected components of reciprocal five-nearest-neighbor DepMap target-feature edges at cosine >= 0.40, using the frozen 613 development targets.

gates.same_gates_on_nested_oof_and_final_fixed: Family nonnegativity, macro thresholds, target-block bootstrap, both null p95 comparisons, and both concentration checks are required independently for nested OOF and the final fixed candidate.

freeze.source_preparation_access: Candidate construction uses only control expression plus target batch/depth metadata. K562 additionally streams all X rows solely to verify ncounts equals the row sum; Orion additionally reads NEGR1 expression solely to reconstruct the frozen legacy control. No targeting expression vector contributes to the candidate correction.
